name: BN6's panel restore timer
why: BN6's panel update writes a plain panel's restore timer every frame, 0x708 at +0x12, a place BN5's panel layout has no twin for (BN5's +0x12 is BN6's +0x10, the alliance timer, compared). Exact: those two bytes, that value; the alliance timer (+0x10) and the panel's flags (+0x14) stay compared.
evidence: BN6's update of a plain panel: 0x0800C3C8-0x0800C3D0 writes 0x708 to +0x12 (and +0x0E at 0x0800C488)
the alliance timer's setter: BN5 0x0800B2D6 (strh at +0x12) / BN6 0x0800CC14 (strh at +0x10)
